name: ytstats
description: Pull your YouTube channel stats and analytics as JSON. Bring your own Google Cloud credentials, no server, no data leaves your machine.
author: Nicolas Dao

overridesRationale.gaxios: googleapis-common pins gaxios 7.1.3, which drags in rimraf > glob > minimatch > brace-expansion and a high-severity DoS advisory (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg). gaxios 7.1.4+ dropped that chain. Same major version, so this is a patch-level floor, not a compatibility risk. Remove once googleapis-common raises its own floor.
